re-001.headline: Make sunlight part of your everyday energy plan.
re-001.intro: Start your solar installation with the equipment that captures the energy. Rahat solar panels form the generation side of a matched system for your home or business.
overview: A solar panel uses photovoltaic cells to convert sunlight into DC electricity. In a complete system, that electricity is managed by compatible power electronics and, where included, stored in a battery or converted by an inverter for suitable AC equipment.

This listing brings the Rahat panel range into your project plan. The right panel choice depends on its actual wattage, voltage and current characteristics, as well as the space available and the equipment it will connect to. The exact wattage of the supplied panel has not been specified in this listing.

Good results start before installation: consider shading, usable roof or ground area, mounting direction and cable routes. A matched array gives the installer a sound foundation for designing the rest of your energy system.

faq.question: Can a panel power my appliances on its own?
faq.answer: Most household AC appliances require a suitable complete system, including compatible power conversion and protection. A panel is a generation component rather than a household socket.

faq.answer: That depends on energy demand, sunlight, available space and the rest of the system. Share your appliance list and installation location for an array proposal.

re-004.headline: Bring essential power into focus.
re-004.intro: The Rahat 3.5kVA solar inverter is a central component in a matched solar and storage installation. Choose it around the equipment you need to run, then build the rest of the system to suit.
overview: An inverter converts DC electricity into AC electricity for compatible AC appliances. In a solar installation, it is one of the key pieces connecting the energy side of the system with the equipment you want to use.
This model carries a listed 3.5kVA rating. It is the entry capacity in the three-model Rahat inverter collection, making it a starting point for a focused essential-load plan.

The right choice starts with continuous demand and the extra power some appliances need when starting. kVA is an apparent-power rating; it should not be treated as a guaranteed identical kW output. Check the exact model’s rated watts, surge capability and supported battery and solar inputs before finalising the installation.

re-007.headline: A focused starting point for essential backup.
re-007.intro: Keep energy available for the moments you need it. The Rahat 5kWh lithium battery adds storage to a compatible power system, giving your installer a clear capacity to plan around.
overview: The 5kWh model is a lithium battery for storing electricity and making it available later through a compatible inverter. It is a storage component, so it should be selected alongside the equipment that will charge it and turn stored energy into usable power.

This is the smallest capacity in the Rahat lithium range shown here. It is a useful starting point when your priority is a focused selection of essential loads rather than the broadest possible backup coverage.

Capacity describes stored energy, not how much equipment can run at once. The complete system’s usable energy, discharge limits, inverter rating and connected appliances determine the result you get. A correctly matched installation turns the product capacity into a practical backup plan.
